editorial:
Imagine being fifteen years old and feeling like your whole world is falling apart because your parents are splitting up. That is exactly where you find Sarah, a young girl who just wants to escape the stress of her home life. At first, she finds that a few drinks help her relax and forget her problems, but it quickly turns into a secret habit that she cannot stop. The vibe of the movie is heavy and honest, showing you how a small choice can turn into a huge problem before any of the adults even notice what is happening.

You will be amazed by the acting here because it feels so real and not like a scripted TV show. The pacing is steady, and it does a great job of showing how Sarah hides her drinking from everyone. While it is a sad story, it is an important look at mental health for teens. If you want to see this, you should look for it on streaming or add the Blu-ray to your physical collection to keep it. It is a powerful watch for parents or anyone who likes stories about overcoming hard times.
endingExplained: The movie ends with Sarah hitting rock bottom as her drinking makes her life a mess. She eventually realizes she cannot fix things on her own and agrees to get help. The final scenes show her entering a treatment program to get sober. It does not have a magic happy ending where everything is perfect, but it gives you hope that Sarah can recover if she stays committed to her sobriety.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves honest stories about family struggles and recovery.
